dataLineage.statement:
Layer was downloaded as a shapefile by ITOS from an email from the IMO. It was then analyzed by ITOS for errors. Those errors were corrected and then the layer was sent back to UNOCHA as a feature class within a file database.
The following errors were found and fixed by ITOS: 1. Fixed leading space errors in 4 Admin2 and 16 Admin3 Arabic names.
The following errors were found by ITOS but left in candidate: 1. The Admin2 p-codes are based on 6 Admin1 units while the Admin1 p-codes are based on 8 Admin1 units, thus creating conflicts in pcodes LB21, LB22 and LB51. 2. The Admin3 p-codes in the Admin3 layer do not build off of the Admin1 and Admin2 p-codes and they are numeric instead of alphanumeric. IMO has instructed ITOS to leave p-codes as is. 3. Two Admin3 units use AR name "كنيسة" while the EN names are "Kneisset Baalbek" and "Knisseh". Also, the AR name "مغيره" is used for both "Mghayreh Jbeil" and "Moughayret Ech-Chouf".
